title: Storm restoration at night - Terralong Street, Kiama
location: Terralong Street, Kiama NSW (near Shoalhaven Street)
summary: A tired two-person crew at night with conductors down. Shows fatigue and night-work hazards and gaps the supervisor must resolve before sign-off.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Alright Mei, quick brief. Storm job, a tree's come down on the LV across Terralong Street in Kiama. Incident 88213.

lines.speaker: u-crew-4
lines.text: It's pitch black and still raining. The conductors are on the road, tangled in the branches.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Treat everything as live until we prove otherwise. Nobody goes within eight metres of those wires.

lines.speaker: u-crew-4
lines.text: Police have closed the street at both ends, so traffic's sorted.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Control says the transformer fuses are still in. I'll pull the LV fuses at the transformer and tag them, then we test dead and earth both sides.

lines.speaker: u-crew-4
lines.text: Copy. I'll set up the light tower, and we've both got head torches and reflective vests.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: The chainsaw work only starts once it's earthed. Chaps, helmet and visor, earmuffs.

lines.speaker: u-crew-4
lines.text: Honestly I'm cooked. We've been going since six this morning, that's sixteen hours.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Yeah, me too. Let's just get this one done.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Muster point is the car park behind the surf club. Nearest hospital is Kiama Hospital. I'm first aider, comms is the radio to control on channel two.
